verdict.rationale: Lindy routines are documented as hands-off automation where you "set a schedule or trigger once" and Lindy runs the job on autopilot, so event-triggered automation is a first-party feature. The evidence does not say which events can serve as triggers or how rules and conditions are defined. Auto-invoked skills respond to requests, not events, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documented event/trigger types, rule or condition definition details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Lindy routines turn your recurring work into hands-off automation — set a schedule or trigger once, and Lindy runs the whole job for you on autopilot
